outcome: Student can join strings using the + operator.

en.title: Joining Strings (Concatenation)
en.body_md:
In computer programming, combining multiple separate pieces of text into a cohesive sentence is one of the most frequent operations you will perform. In Python, joining two or more strings together end-to-end is formally known as string concatenation, and it is accomplished using the plus operator `+`.

Think of string concatenation as taking two separate strips of paper and gluing their ends together securely into one continuous paper strip.

```python
word1 = "Hello"
word2 = "World"
print(word1 + word2)       # HelloWorld
print(word1 + " " + word2) # Hello World
```

Notice that concatenation does not automatically insert spaces between words for you; you must explicitly provide any necessary space characters inside your string literals. Concatenation is strictly designed for strings; combining a string directly with a raw integer number requires type conversion. Mastering concatenation gives you full creative freedom to assemble customized greetings, build dynamic database queries, and display formatted messages. Programmers commonly combine user profile names with custom greeting templates, localized status alerts, and structured system notifications across web services.

te.title: స్ట్రింగ్స్ కలపడం (Concatenation)
te.body_md:
మీరు `+` ఆపరేటర్ వాడి రెండు స్ట్రింగ్స్ ని కలపవచ్చు. దీన్నే **concatenation** అంటారు.

రెండు కాగితాలను గమ్‌తో అతికించినట్లు.

```python
word1 = "Hello"
word2 = "World"
print(word1 + word2)       # HelloWorld
print(word1 + " " + word2) # Hello World
```

try_it: Change the space `" "` to a comma `","`.

challenge.instructions_md: Read a name using `input()`. Print exactly `Namaste, <name>!` using string concatenation `+`.
hints: You need to join three strings: `"Namaste, "`, `name`, and `"!"`.
Don't forget the spaces. `Namaste, ` is one complete string with a space at the end.

teaching_notes: Spacing is tricky. Students might miss the space after comma: 'Namaste,'.

quiz.explanation_md: String concatenation merges A and B together into AB.

quiz.prompt_md:
If user types `5`, what prints?
```python
x = input()
print(x + x)
```
quiz.explanation_md: input() returns a string, so '5' + '5' concatenates into '55'.

recap: Spaces must be added manually inside quotes
common_mistakes: Missing spaces inside the string quotes
